title: The Impact of Post-training on Data Contamination
paper_type_zh: 训练生命周期的数据污染审计论文
best_for_zh: 维护推理基准、评估后训练模型或设计污染审计的研究者。
one_line: Controlled clean-versus-contaminated models show that SFT and GRPO can resurface leakage after extended pre-training.
受控配对实验表明，SFT 与 GRPO 会重新暴露预训练污染，且外部迁移边界不同。
why: It makes post-training a necessary stage in contamination audits rather than treating base-model measurements as definitive.
inclusion_reason: Controlled study of how post-training changes the observed effect of benchmark contamination.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Contamination audits usually measure a checkpoint immediately after pre-training, although deployed models are subsequently shaped by SFT or RL. A small apparent leakage gap can therefore hide information that post-training later exploits, producing misleading math and code scores.

The paper creates matched clean and contaminated continuations of open checkpoints, then applies SFT or GRPO and evaluates both leaked and non-leaked benchmarks. Its output is a controlled audit of when post-training turns dormant benchmark overlap into inflated or transferable performance.

现有污染审计多在预训练刚结束时测量模型，却忽略实际部署模型还会经历 SFT 或 RL。泄漏带来的分数差距此时可能看似很小，但被后训练重新利用后会夸大数学和代码基准成绩，使“已去除污染影响”的判断失效。

论文为同一开源检查点构造干净与含污染的配对续训模型，再分别施加 SFT 或 GRPO，并同时评测泄漏基准和未泄漏的同能力基准。它提供的是一个受控审计：后训练何时把潜伏的重叠转化为虚高表现，何时又可能转化为可迁移能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a lifecycle contamination experiment: identical Qwen2.5 and Gemma3 checkpoints differ only by five injected copies of GSM8K and MBPP test items, then receive matched SFT or rule-reward GRPO. The evaluation surface is the clean–contaminated score difference on leaked versus counterpart benchmarks. Unlike base-only studies, it attributes the visible gap to the interaction between exposure, continued pre-training, post-training recipe, and scale; no official downloadable dataset beyond paper materials was identified.
核心贡献是一次覆盖训练生命周期的污染实验：相同的 Qwen2.5 与 Gemma3 检查点只在预训练语料中相差五份 GSM8K、MBPP 测试题注入，随后接受配对的 SFT 或基于规则奖励的 GRPO。评测对象是泄漏基准与对应未泄漏基准上的干净—污染分差。它不再只看 base model，而是分离暴露、后续预训练、后训练配方和模型规模的共同作用；除论文材料外，未找到官方可下载数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build paired continuations. Starting from Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B and Gemma3 1B/4B base checkpoints, train on a 25B-token FineWeb-Edu, CodeParrots, and OpenMath-Instruct mixture.
  1. Inject the treatment. Put five prompted copies of GSM8K and MBPP test items in the first 2B tokens of only the contaminated mixture; train over 23B later clean tokens.
  1. Post-train independently. Fine-tune on each task’s training split, or run GRPO with rule-based rewards; cap both post-training recipes at roughly equal update counts.
  1. Audit the outcome. Compare paired models on GSM8K/MBPP and on GSMPlus/HumanEval. LM Evaluation Harness and math-verify define scoring; the key audit signal is the contaminated-minus-clean difference. Training seeds and full release configuration require verification.

1. 构造配对续训。以 Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B 和 Gemma3 1B/4B 基座检查点为输入，在由 FineWeb-Edu、CodeParrots、OpenMath-Instruct 组成的 25B token 语料上续训。
  1. 注入处理因素。仅在污染组前 2B token 中放入五份带提示的 GSM8K、MBPP 测试题，之后继续用超过 23B token 的干净数据训练。
  1. 独立后训练。分别用任务训练集进行 SFT，或以规则奖励运行 GRPO；两种配方的更新步数大致对齐。
  1. 审计输出。比较配对模型在 GSM8K/MBPP 与 GSMPlus/HumanEval 上的表现。LM Evaluation Harness 和 math-verify 负责计分，核心信号是污染减干净的分差；训练随机种子和完整发布配置仍待核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: post-training can reveal contamination that base-model evaluation masks. In the controlled Qwen2.5 and Gemma3 comparisons, the same 25B-token continuation and matched update budgets isolate the injected test items and recipe. After post-training, leaked-task gaps exceed 2 percentage points for every reported math and code setting except Qwen2.5-0.5B SFT on GSM8K, reaching 4 points for Qwen2.5-0.5B (Figures 3–4). SFT's extra gap is largely absent on GSMPlus/HumanEval, whereas GRPO also produces a smaller positive gap there (Figure 5). This supports a post-training audit requirement, not universal claims about proprietary or larger models.

核心主张是后训练会揭露 base model 评测掩盖的污染。受控比较在 Qwen2.5、Gemma3 上使用同一 25B token 续训语料和对齐更新预算，因此主要差异是注入测试题与后训练配方。后训练后，除 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的 GSM8K SFT 外，报告的数学、代码设置中泄漏任务分差都超过 2 个百分点；Qwen2.5-0.5B 达到 4 点（图3–4）。SFT 的额外分差在 GSMPlus/HumanEval 上基本不出现，而 GRPO 在这些未泄漏集上也有较小正分差（图5）。证据支持必须在后训练后审计，不足以外推到更大或闭源模型。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier controlled contamination work usually measures immediately after pre-training, while post-finetuning studies used smaller classification models. This paper changes the decision point: it follows matched billion-parameter math and code models through SFT and GRPO and tests both leaked and counterpart tasks. The novelty is not injecting benchmarks itself, but locating contamination measurement after realistic post-training and separating local score inflation from external transfer. It does not establish a general detector or a mitigation method.
既有受控污染研究通常在预训练结束后立即测量，后微调研究又多限于较小的分类模型。本文改变的是测量节点：让配对的十亿参数数学、代码模型经历 SFT 与 GRPO，并同时检查泄漏任务和同能力的未泄漏任务。新意不在于注入测试集本身，而在于把污染度量放到现实后训练之后，并区分局部虚高与外部迁移；它没有提出通用检测器或缓解算法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors isolate a late five-copy injection, whereas real leakage can be paraphrased, repeated, or distributed through pre-training; the reported dynamics may change. They also cover only two open families up to 4B parameters and rule-reward GRPO, so proprietary models, other RLHF objectives, and human preferences remain untested. Reuse should reproduce the clean counterpart and assess both leaked and matched clean benchmarks rather than treating one inflated score as memorization proof.
作者只隔离了“早期注入五份”的情形，而真实泄漏可能是改写、反复出现或分散在预训练全过程中，动力学未必相同。实验也只覆盖两类不超过 4B 的开源模型和规则奖励 GRPO，闭源模型、其他 RLHF 目标及人类偏好信号均未验证。复用时应同时复现实验的干净对照，并评测泄漏集与配对的干净集，不能把单一高分直接当作记忆证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An evaluation maintainer with a benchmark, clean starting checkpoints, and a trusted task-training split can reuse the paired-treatment design: inject a documented overlap, retain a clean continuation, apply the intended post-training recipe, and report leaked and counterpart scores. The output is an audit curve showing whether a gain is local leakage or transfer. Check matched compute, prompts, answer parsing, and confidence intervals. Do not use the design to estimate contamination in an opaque model without a clean counterfactual.
若评测维护者拥有基准、干净起点检查点和可信的任务训练划分，可复用这套配对处理：注入有记录的重叠，保留干净续训对照，施加目标后训练配方，并报告泄漏集和对应集的分数。输出是判断收益来自局部泄漏还是迁移的审计曲线。应核对计算预算、提示、答案解析与置信区间；没有干净反事实的闭源模型不适合用此设计估计污染。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: post-training can reactivate benchmark leakage that looks dormant after continued pre-training.
  • Mechanism: compare clean and five-copy-injected 25B-token continuations before and after matched SFT or GRPO.
  • Artifact: the paper and supplementary material are public; no separate official downloadable dataset was identified.
  • Evidence anchor: post-training leaked-task gaps exceed 2 points in nearly all reported settings and reach 4 points; Figure 5 separates SFT-local from GRPO-transfer effects.
  • Reuse decision: use it for lifecycle contamination audits; first build a clean counterfactual and a matched non-leaked benchmark.

• 定位：后训练可重新激活在持续预训练后看似沉寂的基准泄漏。
  • 方法抓手：对比干净与五份注入的 25B token 续训模型，再施加对齐的 SFT 或 GRPO。
  • 数据与材料：论文及补充材料公开；未找到独立官方可下载数据集。
  • 证据锚点：后训练后大多数报告设置的泄漏任务分差超过 2 点，最高为 4 点；图5区分 SFT 的局部效应与 GRPO 的迁移效应。
  • 复用决定：适合训练生命周期污染审计；先构造干净反事实和配对未泄漏基准。
